manifest.title: Editorial Team
manifest.description: A writer drafts a shared artifact, editors critique and the writer revises, dissents are recorded against the final synthesis, and the deliverable lives as a versioned shared document (CAS-guarded, validator-bounded) rather than prose scattered through the transcript.

requiredRoles.description: Drafts and revises the shared document

config.name: Editorial Team
config.description: Peer-review authoring around a shared artifact with recorded dissents

phases.name: Draft
phases.inputTemplate:
Draft the requested document for:
"{question}"

Create it as a shared artifact (createArtifact) so the editors can propose changes against a versioned copy, then summarize what you drafted.

phases.name: Editorial Review
phases.inputTemplate:
Review the shared artifact for:
"{question}"

Read it (readArtifact), then either propose a concrete improvement (proposeArtifactUpdate, re-reading first if your version is stale) or state precisely why it is ready as-is.
